title.zh: 用主同余给有限代数的点对着色
title.en: Color pairs of a finite algebra by principal congruences

given.zh: 先设有非空有限代数 A 与序同构 e:L≃oCon(A)。定义 c(x,y)=e⁻¹(Cg(x,y))。
given.en: Suppose a nonempty finite algebra A has an order isomorphism e:L≃oCon(A). Set c(x,y)=e⁻¹(Cg(x,y)).

claim.zh: 这个颜色满足对称、零色当且仅当两点相等、三角 join 界，以及区分 a≰b 的边色见证。
claim.en: These colors satisfy symmetry, color zero exactly on the diagonal, the triangle join bound, and separation of any a≰b by an edge color.

statement.zh: Cg(x,y)≤θ ⇔ x θ y；定义 c(x,y)=e⁻¹(Cg(x,y))。
statement.en: Cg(x,y)≤θ iff x θ y; define c(x,y)=e⁻¹(Cg(x,y)).

reason.zh: 主同余是所有包含该点对的同余之交；它包含自己的生成点对，并且小于每个包含它的同余。
reason.en: The principal congruence intersects all congruences containing the pair. It contains its generating pair and lies below every congruence containing that pair.

statement.zh: Cg(x,y)=Cg(y,x)，且 Cg(x,y)=⊥ ⇔ x=y。
statement.en: Cg(x,y)=Cg(y,x), and Cg(x,y)=⊥ iff x=y.

reason.zh: 每个同余都是对称关系，所以交换生成点对不改变最小同余；底同余恰是相等关系。
reason.en: Every congruence is symmetric, so swapping the generating pair leaves the least congruence unchanged. The bottom congruence is equality.

statement.zh: Cg(x,y)≤Cg(x,z)∨Cg(z,y)，因此 c(x,y)≤c(x,z)∨c(z,y)。
statement.en: Cg(x,y)≤Cg(x,z)∨Cg(z,y), hence c(x,y)≤c(x,z)∨c(z,y).

reason.zh: 右边同余同时包含 x∼z 和 z∼y，传递性给出 x∼y；再用主同余最小性及序同构保持 join。
reason.en: The congruence on the right contains x∼z and z∼y, hence x∼y by transitivity. Use the least-congruence property and preservation of joins by the order isomorphism.

statement.zh: a≰b ⇒ e(a)≰e(b) ⇒ 存在 (x,y)∈e(a)∖e(b)，故 c(x,y)≤a 且 c(x,y)≰b。
statement.en: If a≰b, then e(a)≰e(b), so some (x,y) lies in e(a) but not e(b), giving c(x,y)≤a and c(x,y)≰b.

reason.zh: 同余的序是关系包含；不包含便有具体点对见证，再由第一行的等价把成员关系转回颜色的序界。
reason.en: Congruence order is relation inclusion. Failed inclusion supplies a pair, and the first equivalence converts membership into the color-order bounds.

title.zh: 证明种子的兼容像边所成等价闭包本身是同余
title.en: Show that the equivalence closure of compatible seed images is a congruence

given.zh: 给定有限种子集 S，把每条种子经保持所有同余的一元映射 f 的像收集为 TranslateRel。
given.en: For a finite seed set S, TranslateRel consists of images of its pairs under unary maps f preserving every congruence.

claim.zh: 若每个包含 S 的同余都包含 (x,y)，则 x,y 在 TranslateRel 的等价闭包中相连。
claim.en: If every congruence containing S contains (x,y), then the equivalence closure of TranslateRel connects x to y.

statement.zh: 令 R=EqvGen(TranslateRel(S))；恒等映射把 S 放入 R，兼容映射的复合使 R 在这些映射下封闭。
statement.en: Let R=EqvGen(TranslateRel(S)). Identity places S in R, and composition of compatible maps makes R closed under those maps.

reason.zh: TranslateRel 的边是 f(u),f(v)，其中 (u,v)∈S；再作用 g 后只需把映射替换为 g∘f。等价闭包的自反、对称、传递步骤也保留这一性质。
reason.en: An edge has endpoints f(u),f(v) for (u,v)∈S. Applying g replaces f by g∘f; reflexive, symmetric and transitive closure steps retain the same property.

statement.zh: 对任意基本操作 ω，固定其余输入所得 fᵢ(t)=ω(z₀,…,zᵢ₋₁,t,zᵢ₊₁,…) 保持全部同余。
statement.en: For any basic operation ω, each map fᵢ(t)=ω(z₀,…,zᵢ₋₁,t,zᵢ₊₁,…) preserves every congruence.

reason.zh: 两个输入列表只有第 i 项相关，其余项与自身相关；将这些关系交给同余的操作兼容性即可。
reason.en: The two input lists are related in coordinate i, with identical entries elsewhere. Congruence compatibility with the operation gives the result.

statement.zh: 若各坐标 uᵢ R vᵢ，按 i 逐一替换得到 ω(u) R ω(v)。
statement.en: If uᵢ R vᵢ in every coordinate, replace coordinates one at a time to obtain ω(u) R ω(v).

reason.zh: 每次替换使用上一行的兼容一元映射；有限多个替换由 R 的传递性拼接，所以 R 本身也是同余。
reason.en: Each replacement uses a compatible unary map from the preceding line. Transitivity joins the finitely many replacements, proving that R is a congruence.

statement.zh: 将 θ=R 代入“每个包含 S 的同余都包含 (x,y)”的假设，得到 x R y。
statement.en: Apply the hypothesis to θ=R to obtain x R y.

reason.zh: 第一行已使 R 包含所有种子，上一行已证明它是同余，因此它正是这个全称假设允许代入的对象。
reason.en: The first line places every seed in R and the preceding line makes R a congruence, so it is a valid instance of the universal assumption.

title.zh: 从种子颜色的上界得到 Marked 连接链
title.en: Obtain a Marked chain from the seed-color join bound

given.zh: 设 S 是非空有限种子集，T=∨_{(u,v)∈S}c(u,v)，且 c(x,y)≤T；颜色仍由主同余经 e⁻¹ 定义。
given.en: Let S be a nonempty finite seed set, T=∨_{(u,v)∈S}c(u,v), and assume c(x,y)≤T, using the principal-congruence colors.

claim.zh: x,y 满足 Connected c S；五条图公理因而全部成立，表示可推出图见证。
claim.en: Connected c S holds for x,y. All five graph axioms follow, giving a graph witness from a representation.

statement.zh: 对非空有限 S，设 T=∨_{(u,v)∈S}c(u,v)。若 θ 包含 S，则每项 c(u,v)≤e⁻¹θ，故 T≤e⁻¹θ。
statement.en: For nonempty finite S, put T=∨_{(u,v)∈S}c(u,v). If θ contains S, every c(u,v)≤e⁻¹θ, hence T≤e⁻¹θ.

reason.zh: 种子在 θ 内等价于它的主同余在 θ 以下；有限 join 也仍低于这个共同上界。
reason.en: A seed belongs to θ exactly when its principal congruence is below θ. The finite join is therefore below this common upper bound.

statement.zh: c(x,y)≤T≤e⁻¹θ ⇒ Cg(x,y)≤θ ⇒ x θ y。
statement.en: c(x,y)≤T≤e⁻¹θ implies Cg(x,y)≤θ and then x θ y.

reason.zh: 这对每个包含 S 的同余 θ 都成立，因而满足上一大步产生 TranslateRel 链的条件。
reason.en: This holds for every congruence θ containing S, meeting the previous step’s condition for a TranslateRel chain.

statement.zh: 若 f 保持全部同余，则 Cg(fu,fv)≤Cg(u,v)，因此 c(fu,fv)≤c(u,v)。
statement.en: If f preserves all congruences, Cg(fu,fv)≤Cg(u,v), hence c(fu,fv)≤c(u,v).

reason.zh: 将 f 的保持性用于 Cg(u,v) 中自己的生成点对；所得像点对仍在该同余内，主同余最小性给出所需界。
reason.en: Apply preservation by f to the generating pair in Cg(u,v). Its image pair remains in that congruence, and minimality of the new principal congruence gives the bound.

statement.zh: 每条 TranslateRel 边都是 admissible 像种子边，故整条链也是 Connected c S。
statement.en: Every TranslateRel edge is an admissible image of a seed, so the entire chain is Connected c S.

reason.zh: 上一行正是 admissible 的定义；逐条保留等价闭包的四种构造，就把链变成第五图公理要求的 Marked 连接。
reason.en: The preceding inequality is exactly admissibility. Preserving each equivalence-closure constructor converts the chain into the Marked connection required by the fifth axiom.

title.zh: 把所有不增色映射列为一元基本操作
title.en: Use every color-nonincreasing map as a unary basic operation

given.zh: 现有有限非空顶点集 Fin n 及图见证 c。以全部 admissible 自映射作为代数基本操作；有限顶点集使这些操作的数量也有限。
given.en: Start with a witness c on nonempty Fin n. Take all admissible self-maps as basic unary operations; there are finitely many because the vertex set is finite.

claim.zh: 对每个 a∈L，关系 ρ(a)(x,y)⇔c(x,y)≤a 是这个有限代数的同余。
claim.en: For each a∈L, the relation ρ(a)(x,y) iff c(x,y)≤a is a congruence of this finite algebra.

statement.zh: 基本操作取 {f:Fin n→Fin n | ∀x,y，c(fx,fy)≤c(x,y)} 中的全部映射，每个操作元数为 1。
statement.en: Take every f:Fin n→Fin n satisfying c(fx,fy)≤c(x,y) as a unary basic operation.

reason.zh: Fin n 的自映射只有 nⁿ 个，因此这个子集有限，可以逐个编号成为所需有限代数的操作表。
reason.en: There are only nⁿ self-maps of Fin n, so this subset is finite and can be enumerated as the operation table of a finite algebra.

statement.zh: 定义 ρ(a)(x,y) ⇔ c(x,y)≤a；由零色、对称和三角界得到自反、对称、传递。
statement.en: Define ρ(a)(x,y) iff c(x,y)≤a. Zero color, symmetry and the triangle bound give reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity.

reason.zh: 传递性具体为 c(x,z)≤c(x,y)∨c(y,z)≤a；因此每个 ρ(a) 先是等价关系。
reason.en: Transitivity reads c(x,z)≤c(x,y)∨c(y,z)≤a, making each ρ(a) an equivalence relation.

statement.zh: x ρ(a) y ⇒ c(fx,fy)≤c(x,y)≤a ⇒ fx ρ(a) fy。
statement.en: If x ρ(a) y, then c(fx,fy)≤c(x,y)≤a, so fx ρ(a) fy.

reason.zh: 每个基本操作按定义不增色，故该等价关系与全部基本操作兼容，确实成为一个同余。
reason.en: Every basic operation is color-nonincreasing by construction, so the equivalence relation respects all basic operations and is a congruence.

title.zh: 取 θ 内全部点对的颜色 join，恢复 θ
title.en: Recover θ from the join of colors of all its pairs

given.zh: 任取所构造代数的同余 θ，令 S={(x,y):x θ y}，a=∨_{(x,y)∈S}c(x,y)。n>0 保证 S 含一个对角点对，因而非空。
given.en: For a congruence θ of the constructed algebra, take S={(x,y):x θ y} and a=∨_{(x,y)∈S}c(x,y). Since n>0, S contains a diagonal pair and is nonempty.

claim.zh: x θ y 当且仅当 c(x,y)≤a，所以 θ=ρ(a)，映射 ρ 是满射。
claim.en: x θ y iff c(x,y)≤a. Thus θ=ρ(a), and ρ is surjective.

statement.zh: S={(u,v):u θ v}，a=∨_{(u,v)∈S}c(u,v)；n>0 使 (x,x)∈S，故 S 非空。
statement.en: Let S={(u,v):u θ v} and a=∨_{(u,v)∈S}c(u,v). Since n>0, a diagonal pair (x,x) belongs to S, so S is nonempty.

reason.zh: 顶点集有限使 S 可用有限 join；θ 自反且存在顶点，保证可以使用只针对非空种子的第五图公理。
reason.en: Finiteness permits the finite join. Reflexivity of θ and existence of a vertex supply the nonempty-seed hypothesis required by the fifth axiom.

statement.zh: x θ y ⇒ (x,y)∈S ⇒ c(x,y)≤a，即 θ≤ρ(a)。
statement.en: If x θ y, then (x,y)∈S and c(x,y)≤a; thus θ≤ρ(a).

reason.zh: 任一有限 join 的项都在该 join 以下，所以 θ 中的每个点对都落入 ρ(a)。
reason.en: Every term lies below its finite join, so every pair in θ belongs to ρ(a).

statement.zh: 反之 c(x,y)≤a ⇒ Connected c S x y；每条 Marked 边仍在 θ 内。
statement.en: Conversely c(x,y)≤a gives Connected c S x y, and every Marked edge remains in θ.

reason.zh: 种子按定义属于 θ；admissible 映射全被列为基本操作，同余兼容性保证种子的每个允许像仍属于 θ。
reason.en: The seeds belong to θ by definition, and every admissible map was included as a basic operation. Congruence compatibility therefore preserves each allowed seed image.

statement.zh: θ 的自反、对称、传递性沿整条连接传播，得 x θ y；所以 θ=ρ(a)。
statement.en: Reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity of θ propagate along the connection, yielding x θ y; hence θ=ρ(a).

reason.zh: 两侧包含逐点相等，因此任意同余都由某个 a 产生，ρ 是到全部同余的满射。
reason.en: The two inclusions give equality pointwise. Every congruence is therefore produced by some a, proving surjectivity of ρ onto all congruences.

title.zh: 用分离边得到序同构，并合并两方向
title.en: Use separating edges to obtain an order isomorphism and the equivalence

given.zh: 每个 ρ(a) 是同余，且 ρ 已满射。图的分离公理说 a≰b 时存在 c(x,y)≤a 但 c(x,y)≰b 的边。
given.en: Each ρ(a) is a congruence and ρ is surjective. The separation axiom supplies c(x,y)≤a but c(x,y)≰b whenever a≰b.

claim.zh: ρ(a)≤ρ(b) 当且仅当 a≤b，故 ρ 是 L 与全部同余格的序同构；最终得到 Representable L↔HasGraphWitness L。
claim.en: ρ(a)≤ρ(b) iff a≤b. Thus ρ is an order isomorphism onto the full congruence lattice, proving Representable L↔HasGraphWitness L.

statement.zh: a≤b ⇒ [c(x,y)≤a ⇒ c(x,y)≤b] ⇒ ρ(a)≤ρ(b)。
statement.en: If a≤b, then c(x,y)≤a implies c(x,y)≤b, so ρ(a)≤ρ(b).

reason.zh: 同余上的序就是点对关系的包含，因此只需逐点使用序的传递性。
reason.en: Congruence order is inclusion of pair relations, so transitivity of the lattice order proves monotonicity pointwise.

statement.zh: 若 ρ(a)≤ρ(b) 但 a≰b，分离公理给出 c(x,y)≤a、c(x,y)≰b，与关系包含矛盾。
statement.en: If ρ(a)≤ρ(b) but a≰b, separation supplies c(x,y)≤a and c(x,y)≰b, contradicting relation inclusion.

reason.zh: 该点对在 ρ(a) 内却不在 ρ(b) 内，所以 ρ 也反映序，并因此单射。
reason.en: That pair belongs to ρ(a) but not ρ(b), so ρ reflects order and is consequently injective.

statement.zh: ρ 是满射序嵌入，故 L≃oCon(A_c)；与主同余着色方向合并，得到 Representable L↔HasGraphWitness L。
statement.en: The map ρ is a surjective order embedding, hence L≃oCon(A_c). Combine this with the principal-color construction to obtain Representable L↔HasGraphWitness L.

reason.zh: 恢复任意同余的步骤提供满射，当前步骤提供序反映；另一方向由前面已完成的五条颜色公理给出。
reason.en: Recovery of arbitrary congruences supplies surjectivity, and this step supplies order reflection. The five color axioms proved in the other branch give the reverse implication.
